preconditions.description: The length of the string S must be between 1 and 100,000.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not any(len(set(S[i:j+1])) == K for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S))) else True
postconditions.description: If no substring with exactly K distinct characters exists, return -1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(len(S[i:j+1]) for i in range(len(S)) for j in range(i, len(S)) if len(set(S[i:j+1])) == K)
postconditions.description: The returned value must be the length of the longest substring with exactly K distinct characters.
